channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Incerteza sobre contas públicas eleva parcela da dívida atrelada à Selic ao maior patamar em 20 anos
item.description: Uncertainty over Brazil's public finances and the international environment has led the National Treasury to increase the share of federal debt linked to the Selic rate to its highest level in 20 years. This strategy reflects a move toward greater flexibility and reduced exposure to long-term risks amid fiscal and external volatility.

item.title: PT patrocina posts enaltecendo governo, e PL impulsiona conteúdo para desgastar Lula
item.description: Before the official electoral campaign begins on August 16, the PT is paying to boost posts that praise Lula's government, while the PL is doing the same to amplify critical content against the president, aiming to damage his image and attract voters on social media.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro declara R$ 8,2 milhões em bens ao TSE; vice informa R$ 565 mil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) declared R$ 8.2 million in assets to the TSE for the 2026 presidential race, while his running mate Alfredo Gaspar (PL) reported R$ 565 thousand. Bolsonaro’s declared wealth increased by 370% since 2018, largely due to a Brasília property valued at R$ 6.2 million. The ticket’s registration was confirmed after a dispute over an alleged affiliation with the Missão party, which the TSE overturned.

item.title: TSE suspende sistema de filiação partidária após caso Flávio e tentativa de alterar partido de Lula
item.description: The TSE suspended the processing of new party affiliations in the FILIA system after detecting attempts to improperly change the party affiliation of President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). Bolsonaro had been wrongly registered as affiliated with the Mission Party, blocking his presidential candidacy, but the TSE restored his PL affiliation and removed the fraudulent link. Despite the attempts, both Lula and Bolsonaro maintained regularized affiliations, and the April 4 deadline for party affiliation had already passed.

item.title: Flávio propõe reformar Judiciário e criar modelo prisional inspirado no de El Salvador
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential candidate in 2026, proposes reforming the Judiciary to reduce the individual power of ministers and judges, creating a prison model inspired by El Salvador's, and classifying criminal factions as narcoterrorist organizations.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete retomar Casa Verde e Amarela e construir 2,5 milhões de residências
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate for the PL party, proposes to revive the Casa Verde e Amarela program to finance 2.5 million homes, offering the lowest possible interest rates for homebuyers. The program, introduced during Jair Bolsonaro's administration, replaced Minha Casa, Minha Vida as an alternative to Workers' Party-era housing policies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende que parlamentares possam ser julgados por instâncias inferiores
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, proposed in his government plan to end the STF's criminal jurisdiction over lawmakers. The change would allow deputies and senators to be tried in lower courts, such as the STJ and TRFs.

item.title: Plano de governo de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe tesouraço e novo teto de gastos
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) unveiled a government plan proposing a 'tesouraço' to cut spending and taxes, alongside a new spending ceiling. The initiative aims to replace the current fiscal framework, reviving a rule abandoned during the transition from Jair Bolsonaro’s to Lula’s administration.

item.title: Flávio diz que e-mails do Missão viraram “spam”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that automated emails sent by the Missão party to his institutional Senate account were classified as 'spam' by his team, concerning a membership he denies requesting. The comment was made during a livestream on Thursday, the 13th, and relates to prior difficulties he faced in registering his presidential candidacy.

item.title: Lula critica bets e diz que população deve evitar dívidas com jogo
item.description: President Lula criticized betting and warned the population to avoid going into debt through gambling, distinguishing productive debt (for purchasing essential goods or improving quality of life) from gambling-related debt, which he deemed harmful and based on lies. He advocated for government stimulation of consumption within families’ payment capacity, excluding gambling. Lula participated for the first time in the RAIS data presentation, highlighting formal job creation since the start of his mandate in January 2023 through June 2026.

item.title: Derrite é condenado pelo TRE-SP por propaganda eleitoral antecipada
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) fined federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP) R$ 5,000 for premature electoral campaigning after he shared an edited video on social media urging support for Flávio Bolsonaro as president and himself as senator. The rapporteur ruled the content clearly exceeded pre-campaign limits by naming specific candidates and calling for public adherence to a political project. The court also ordered the immediate removal of the video, subject to daily fines, with an appeal possible.

item.title: Governo de SP aciona STF e, horas depois, União avaliza empréstimo de R$ 5,4 bilhões
item.description: The São Paulo government, led by Tarcísio de Freitas, sought an STF injunction to unlock a R$ 5.4 billion loan that had been stalled since May. Shortly after, the federal government, through the Ministry of Finance, approved the guarantee, with Banco do Brasil as the lending institution and the state acting as guarantor to secure lower interest rates. The funds will finance infrastructure projects, including metro expansion and highway duplication.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro registra candidatura no TSE
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed his presidential candidacy with the TSE on the evening of August 13, 2026. The submission included the DRAP and required documents for validation by the 22-PL party.

item.title: Governo Lula notifica EUA sobre início de processo de reciprocidade contra tarifaço
item.description: The Brazilian government notified the United States of the initiation of a reciprocity process in response to tariffs imposed on Brazilian products, requesting diplomatic consultations. The move follows the U.S. imposition of additional tariffs on Brazilian goods, prompting a formal Brazilian response to defend its trade interests.

item.title: Gabinete de Flávio ignorou e-mails do Missão por achar que era spam
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro said his office ignored automated emails from the Mission party, treating them as spam, and denied voluntarily attempting to join the party. He also rejected claims that he tried to affiliate with the PT after the Mission incident. The TSE confirmed the Mission party affiliation was entered via its own credentials, not a system breach, and ordered the restoration of his PL affiliation to preserve his presidential candidacy.

item.title: Governo comunica aos EUA que iniciará consultas para aplicar reciprocidade contra tarifas de Trump
item.description: The Brazilian government notified the United States that it will begin the consultation process to apply the Reciprocity Law in response to tariffs imposed by the Trump administration. The first phase involves requesting diplomatic analyses before implementing the retaliatory measures.

item.title: Lindbergh aciona PF para investigar fraude em filiação e pede acareação de Flávio e Renan
item.description: Lindbergh Farias, former PT leader in the Chamber of Deputies, has requested the Federal Police to investigate an alleged fraud in Flávio Bolsonaro’s party affiliation to Missão, as recorded in the TSE system. He also called for a confrontation (acareação) between Flávio Bolsonaro and Renan Calheiros to clarify the accusations. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Renan desafia Flávio a fazer “acareação” sobre filiação à Missão
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, released a video explaining the party affiliation process following controversy over Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) inclusion in the party. He challenged Bolsonaro to a 'confrontation' to clarify the matter, stating that major parties use automated systems for affiliation and that Flávio's case must be transparent.

item.title: Flávio diz que também tentaram filiá-lo ao PT após caso do Missão
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated during a live stream that he received an email indicating a fraudulent attempt to affiliate him with the PT, just hours after the TSE restored his official affiliation with the PL following an erroneous association with the Missão party. He denied any connection to the PT, labeled the organization as criminal, and did not identify those responsible for the attempt.

item.title: Manual do Eleitor: confira as regras para o eleitorado na propaganda eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has issued guidelines for electoral propaganda in Brazil’s 2026 General Elections, allowing spontaneous distribution of flyers and vehicle decals (up to 0.5 m²) starting Sunday (16), with no payment permitted for displaying such material. Voters are encouraged to report irregularities — including vote-buying, misuse of public resources, and illegal propaganda — and to protect themselves from disinformation via official channels, strengthening democratic integrity.

item.title: Ao violar o sigilo da fonte, Moraes fez um favor a Flávio Dino e um desfavor à democracia
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the Federal Police to seize the phone of journalist Luís Pablo Conceição Almeida to uncover the source revealing that Minister Flávio Dino uses an official armored vehicle in Maranhão, violating journalistic source confidentiality. The action, conducted via the long-standing fake news inquiry, was deemed unnecessary and harmful to press freedom, as the information was true and no crime was committed by the reporter. While the breach benefits Dino by shielding his image, it undermines democracy and the STF’s institutional integrity, which appears to act above the Constitution.

item.title: Encontro com Lula acontece quando Alcolumbre tem preocupações reais com operações da PF e eleições
item.description: The second meeting between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre occurs amid government pressure to approve the PEC ending the 6x1 workweek, while Alcolumbre expresses real concerns about Federal Police operations in the election year. Although Alcolumbre is open to negotiation and seeks the meeting, Lula reportedly holds grudges and doubts his support in 2027. Andreazza argues Alcolumbre will not easily grant the PEC’s approval, as he needs to preserve his Senate presence amid a potentially hostile renewal in 2027.

item.title: Defesa de Garotinho pede investigação sobre vazamento de documento do STF
item.description: The defense of Anthony Garotinho, Rio gubernatorial candidate, has requested investigations by the Federal Police, Federal Prosecutor's Office, and Rio State Prosecutor's Office regarding the leak of an STF certificate showing the transit in judgment of his administrative improbity conviction in July 2025, which would extend his political rights suspension until 2033. The defense claims the document was under judicial secrecy and used to disseminate contested electoral information, citing a PGE-RJ watermark as an indicator of origin, though not proving who leaked it. The TRE-RJ is yet to rule on his eligibility.

item.title: Flávio registra candidatura no TSE e declara R$ 8,1 milhões em bens
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) registered his presidential candidacy with the TSE on the night of August 13, declaring R$ 8,186 million in assets — R$ 6.4 million more than in 2018. His wealth is nearly double that of Lula (R$ 4.8 million) but far below Romeu Zema’s (R$ 178.7 million). The filing followed the TSE’s reversal of an unauthorized affiliation with the Missão party and the restoration of his PL membership.

item.title: Candidata ao Senado, Marília Campos declara R$ 1,8 milhão em bens
item.description: Marília Campos (PT), Senate candidate for Minas Gerais, declared R$ 1,802,316.70 in assets to the TSE for the 2026 elections, a 6.7% increase from the R$ 1,688,609.78 declared in 2024. Her largest asset is a house in Contagem valued at R$ 1 million, followed by an apartment (R$ 495,000) and fixed-income investment (R$ 270,000).

item.title: Flávio diz que, além de filiação no Missão, recebeu alerta por e-mail sobre tentativa de filiá-lo ao PT
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) reported receiving automated emails from the Mission party, initially mistaken for spam, which included an unjust payment demand and alleged an attempted fraudulent affiliation with the PT. He stated his presidential candidacy remains secure following a TSE ruling that reinstated his PL affiliation dating back to November 2021 and nullified the Mission party link, which was added without his consent.

item.title: Flávio: Simplificaremos outorgas de irrigação e acelerar regularização fundiária
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, pledged to simplify irrigation permits and accelerate land regularization, backed by much of Brazil's agribusiness sector. His government plan includes expanding rural insurance, securitization tools, and debt restructuring mechanisms for agriculture.

item.title: Zema, sobre segurança pública: Quero fazer uso da lei da GLO
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, stated he intends to use Garantia da Lei e da Ordem (GLO) operations to combat organized crime, emphasizing that federal action will be discussed with governors and not imposed unilaterally.

item.title: Renan Santos: Queremos metas para municípios e quem não cumprir não poderá se reeleger
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, proposed that if elected, he would establish performance targets for municipalities, particularly those reliant on federal transfers. He stated that municipalities failing to meet these targets would not be allowed to reelect their mayors.

item.title: Flávio defende redução gradual da CDE e de fontes incentivadas, mantendo a tarifa social
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro of the PL party proposes a gradual reduction of the Energy Development Account (CDE) and incentivized energy sources, while maintaining the social tariff for low-income consumers. The plan aims to lower sectoral charges on electricity bills without compromising energy access for vulnerable populations.

item.title: Renan Santos desafia Flávio e propõe acareação sobre filiação ao Missão
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, challenged Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to a public confrontation to clarify the alleged irregular affiliation of the senator to the party. Renan claims that access logs from the Missão party's system show that Flávio's official Senate email was used to register him, including opening emails and clicking confirmation links, suggesting knowledge by the senator's team. He accuses Flávio's campaign of playing the victim and urges both sides to present their access data to verify the truth.

item.title: TSE restabelece filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao PL após registro indevido no partido Missão
item.description: The TSE reinstated Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Liberal Party (PL) after discovering he had been incorrectly linked to the Mission Party. The system error had unenrolled the senator, jeopardizing his candidacy just days before the registration deadline. The case has been referred to the Federal Police for investigation into potential irregularities.

item.title: Senado autoriza operações de crédito de R$ 3,6 bilhões da gestão Nunes
item.description: The Federal Senate authorized São Paulo City Hall to contract three international credit operations totaling US$701.9 million (about R$3.62 billion) with the IDB and World Bank, intended for bus fleet electrification and the Avança Saúde II hospital restructuring program. The approval followed pressure from Mayor Ricardo Nunes, who had criticized delays despite prior technical approval from the National Treasury and PGFN. On the same day, the Ministry of Finance authorized R$5.4 billion in loans from the São Paulo state government to Banco do Brasil after the state successfully urged the STF to release funds allegedly being withheld without justification.

item.title: Governo Lula abre processo de reciprocidade contra tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The Lula government has initiated a reciprocity process against unilateral tariffs imposed by the United States, under Brazil’s Economic Reciprocity Law (Law No. 15,122/2025). Brazil has requested diplomatic consultations with the U.S. through Camex and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, following Decree No. 12,551/2025. The analysis is underway as per Chapter V of the decree.

item.title: Governo Lula anuncia abertura de reciprocidade por tarifaço de Trump e notifica EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government notified the United States of the initiation of a reciprocity process in response to 25% tariffs imposed on Brazilian exports, under the 2025 Economic Reciprocity Law. The tariffs affect $5.8 billion in exports, primarily impacting wood, furniture, machinery, footwear, ceramics, and sugar. Brazil seeks diplomatic resolution, rejecting U.S. claims of unfair trade practices related to Pix, deforestation, and corruption.

item.title: Justiça determina remoção de post com imagem falsa de governadora apoiadora de Lula abraçada com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Pernambuco Regional Electoral Court (TRE-PE) ordered the removal of a social media post using AI to create a false image of Governor Raquel Lyra embracing Flávio Bolsonaro, labeling it as premature negative propaganda. The post, published on August 5 by the Juventude 40 profile supportive of João Campos, was reported by Lyra’s coalition and removed within 24 hours. The Pernambuco gubernatorial race features competing claims over Lula’s support and allegations of disinformation between Lyra and Campos.

item.title: Gabinete achou que e-mails do Missão eram spam, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed his office mistook automated emails from the Mission party as spam, resulting in his illegal affiliation and blocking his 2026 presidential candidacy registration. The TSE reinstated his affiliation with the PL and removed the Mission party link, stating the affiliation was not due to hacking but improper use of party credentials. The candidacy registration deadline is Saturday at 7 PM.

item.title: Haddad tem aumento de R$ 266 mil em patrimônio desde a última eleição
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) declared R$ 861,200 in assets for his 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial candidacy, an increase of R$ 266,000 (+44.7%) since 2022. His holdings include stakes in two companies, R$ 100,900 in a checking account, R$ 436,000 in fixed-income investments (more than double 2022 levels), and 26.3% of a property in Planalto Paulista, while he appears to have sold a previously declared R$ 90,000 apartment.

item.title: Após turbulências, Motta se alinha a Lula, mas não converte capital político em apoio ao pai
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, strengthened his leadership and deepened his relationship with President Lula, supporting government initiatives and preventing defeats in areas such as the economy and public security. Despite this collaboration, he did not secure public backing from Lula for his father, Nabor Wanderley, who is running for Senate in Paraíba and trails in polls. Motta has formally endorsed Lula’s re-election, and the president responded favorably, opening discussion for government support of Motta’s re-election as Chamber president in 2027.

item.title: Além de Flávio Bolsonaro, Missão chegou a filiar Lula
item.description: In addition to Flávio Bolsonaro, former President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was also a victim of fraud that improperly enrolled him in the Mission party. The registration was reversed after the fraud was discovered, and the PL restored his correct affiliation. The exclusive subscriber-only article highlights a scheme of falsified party affiliations.

item.title: Candidato do PT no Maranhão questiona atuação de jornalista alvo de Moraes
item.description: The vice-governor of Maranhão and PT candidate for state governor, Felipe Camarão, stated that no constitutional right is absolute, in response to the search and seizure authorized by Minister Alexandre de Moraes against the source of journalist Luís Pablo. He defended the STF's action in the case during an interview with Papo Antagonista.

item.title: Lula transforma divulgação de dados de emprego em beija-mão com apoiadores
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva personally attended the release of the RAIS at the Ministry of Labor and Employment, embracing supporters as part of a strategy to appear closer to the public. During the event, he discussed campaign topics such as restricting bets, combating household indebtedness, and wealth distribution, while the data showed a 3.6% increase in formal employment links (62.891 million in June 2026), but a 3.3% decline in total payroll and a 2.9% drop in average wages compared to December 2025.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz live com aliados e apresenta plano com 'tesouraço' de gastos e limites para decisões do STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) unveiled his government plan in a live stream with allies, proposing a 'tesouraço' on public spending, limiting STF decisions, lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 (14 for serious crimes), chemical castration of rapists, and designating criminal factions as terrorist organizations. He also introduced the 'Ganha, Ganha' program, a voluntary points system rewarding positive citizen behavior, and an app for vulnerable women. The event featured Alfredo Gaspar (running mate), Rogério Marinho (campaign coordinator), and Daniella Marques (former Caixa president).

item.title: Gakiya comenta convite de Caiado e explica recusa: ‘Perder aposentadoria eu não vou’
item.description: Lincoln Gakiya, a prosecutor from São Paulo’s Gaeco unit, said he was surprised by Ronaldo Caiado’s public signal that he would invite him to lead a future Ministry of Public Security, noting Caiado had not consulted him beforehand. Although honored by the offer and supportive of creating such a ministry to combat criminal factions like PCC and CV, Gakiya declined to discuss it now, citing his commitment to securing his pension after a lifetime of service. He left open the possibility of considering offers after retirement, but stressed he would not sacrifice his pension for any position.

item.title: Janones acusa Flávio de armação para descredibilizar Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) of paying someone to fraudulently register him with the Mission party in an alleged attempt to discredit the Electoral Justice. He also repeated an unfounded conspiracy theory claiming that former President Jair Bolsonaro was not stabbed in 2018, comparing the current situation to the alleged 'script' of the forged stabbing. Flávio Bolsonaro denied the accusations, denounced fraud in his registration, and claimed the system tried to bring him down but failed.

item.title: TSE mantém multa contra a Quaest por falha em pesquisa
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld a fine of over R$ 53,000 against Quaest Research for flaws in an electoral poll conducted in Teresina (PI) during the 2024 elections. The court ruled the firm violated transparency rules by using IBGE technical codes instead of specifying the neighborhoods or areas where interviews were conducted, hindering public oversight. While acknowledging methodological autonomy, the TSE emphasized that this does not exempt research firms from complying with Electoral Justice regulations.

item.title: “Não temos Daniel Vorcaro para financiar campanha”, diz Erika Hilton
item.description: Federal deputy Erika Hilton (PSol-SP), running for re-election, said she lacks support from big business or financial markets to fund her campaign, joking that she doesn’t have Daniel Vorcaro — former owner of Banco Master — in her phone contacts for financing. She defended her modest declared assets (R$15,800), stating it’s impossible to get rich in politics while being honest, and advocated for a Brazil that is LGBT, Black, female, Indigenous, and plural.

item.title: O que pode acontecer na Justiça com quem filiou Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão
item.description: The TSE stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s affiliation with the Mission Party was not due to a hacker attack, but rather the improper use of the party’s access credentials by an authorized person operating the affiliation system. The Court has ordered an investigation into the matter. The article is subscriber-only and highlights concerns about irregularities in the partisan affiliation process.

item.title: Plano de Flávio restringe trans no esporte e reforça pauta antiaborto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's government plan proposes banning transgender athletes from competing in women's sports categories, arguing they retain physical advantages even after hormone therapy. It also calls for expanding civic-military schools, countering alleged political indoctrination in education, and reinforcing conservative stances such as anti-abortion policies.

item.title: Crusoé: PT debocha de filiação de Flávio à Missão
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) used the controversy surrounding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) affiliation with the Missão party to promote its own brand on social media, posting on X: 'Don't be Flávio Bolsonaro. Join the right party!', including a link to PT membership. The move was seen as a political jab against the senator.
